description: Calculate what an LLM workload costs: tokens per request × requests, at list price, with long-context surcharges applied correctly (several providers bill the whole request at a higher rate once the prompt passes a threshold). Name a model for one figure, or omit it to get every model ranked cheapest-first for the same workload.

model.description: Model id or name, e.g. "claude-sonnet-5-5". Omit to compare all models.

name: llm_cost_estimate
title: Estimate LLM API cost
